versions.text: Criterion: Verify that the system safety program addresses materials. Standard: Risks associated with use of new/alternate/substituted/hazardous materials or material deficiencies do not exceed the hazard baseline set for the program. Method of Compliance: Verification method includes inspection of documentation. Evidence of a material safety process is verified by inspection of program safety documentation and safety analyses. Cumulative risks of identified hazards do not exceed the program's hazard baseline. References: MIL-STD-882 SAE ARP4761 14 CFR Section 1309 of Parts 23, 25, 27, 29; and related advisory circulars.
